acceptanceCriteria: Push runs on main reuse a passing merge_group verdict for artifact-integrity, go-static and go-interop when the tree is identical, and still run them in full otherwise.
The reuse binding is to the exact tree and workflow inputs and is shown in the job summary.
Measured: push-run runner-minutes on main before and after over at least five merges, retained.
body: Evidence: owner-requested performance search on 2026-10-17. Measured with corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 615, corvint-tasks build 615, Go 1.27.2, macOS 12-core/64 GB host at load average 80-84 (wall times are inflated by load; CPU times are the stable signal). Lane counts come from orchestrator session 03e2afac subagent transcripts (206 lanes). Run 39050120870 (merge_group, sha c92ee0015) passed every job; the following push run 39051799562 on the same sha skipped the go-product shards through shard reuse (23-32 s each) but reran artifact-integrity in 617 s and go-static in 250 s, plus go-interop 99 s, about 16 runner-minutes per merged PR. With about 2 concurrent Actions runs available (memory: actions capacity throttle), these duplicate jobs delay queued PR and merge_group runs. Expected: on a push to main whose tree equals a merge_group run that passed, the non-test jobs reuse that verdict the way the product shards do. Related: V1-1099 (job-level input predicates), V1-0728 (main push cancellation), V1-1103 (cem01-go runs twice).
title: Push CI on main reruns artifact-integrity (617 s) and go-static (250 s) for a commit the merge queue already passed
